records.title: Bioinformatics analysis identifies AURKB as a prognostic biomarker across multiple human cancers.
records.intervention_type: Bioinformatic prognostic/response correlations; no prospective treatment intervention.
records.model: Pan-cancer TCGA/HPA/CCLE expression, methylation, immune and public drug-sensitivity analyses with>11,000 cases.
records.outcome_direction: AURKB overexpression correlated with poor outcomes and drug-response/immune features, with strong diagnostic ROC claims in selected cancers.
records.note: AURKB overexpression correlated with poor outcomes and drug-response/immune features, with strong diagnostic ROC claims in selected cancers. Correlation does not establish causal drug resistance or treatment benefit; neither sample size nor AUC=1.0 proves independent clinical utility. No named inhibitor is tested.
records.uncertainty: Correlation does not establish causal drug resistance or treatment benefit; neither sample size nor AUC=1.0 proves independent clinical utility. No named inhibitor is tested.

records.title: Case Report: Could genetic factors influence the outcomes of first-line enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab therapy in patients with metastatic urothelial carcinoma? Two cases of patients harbouring a BRCA mutation.
records.intervention_type: First-line enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab, followed by second-line platinum-based chemotherapy of unspecified composition.
records.model: Two BRCA-mutant metastatic urothelial-carcinoma clinical cases.
records.outcome_direction: Both had short progression-free survival on the first-line combination and more durable responses to subsequent platinum chemotherapy.
records.note: Both had short progression-free survival on the first-line combination and more durable responses to subsequent platinum chemotherapy. Preserves actual clinical relative responses without treating two selected nonrandom sequential cases as proof of subgroup superiority or a first-line recommendation. Exact durations/regimens are absent.
records.uncertainty: Preserves actual clinical relative responses without treating two selected nonrandom sequential cases as proof of subgroup superiority or a first-line recommendation. Exact durations/regimens are absent.

records.title: The multiple roles of mps1 in Drosophila female meiosis.
records.intervention_type: Genetic loss/hypomorphic alleles and imaging.
records.model: Drosophila female oocytes lacking Ald/Mps1, studied by live imaging and kinetochore localization.
records.outcome_direction: Premature anaphase after spindle formation left insufficient time for nonexchange chromosome partitioning; outer-kinetochore kinase filaments were described, with a proposed storage role.
records.note: Premature anaphase after spindle formation left insufficient time for nonexchange chromosome partitioning; outer-kinetochore kinase filaments were described, with a proposed storage role. Accelerated exit is a checkpoint defect, not improved meiosis. Filament storage is a hypothesis and no drug was administered; ald is a gene, not aldosterone.
records.uncertainty: Accelerated exit is a checkpoint defect, not improved meiosis. Filament storage is a hypothesis and no drug was administered; ald is a gene, not aldosterone.
